instruction: Remove Ideal Loads From Three-Zone Init Model. Start from the Desktop input model at /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and the weather file at /home/user/Desktop/weather.epw. Modify the input model as the base model rather than copying it unchanged. Use the Desktop reference image /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png only as a visual guide for the starting layout. Modify the model as needed, then save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Every required output must be a valid, non-empty file at the stated Desktop path. The final model requirements are: - the result.osm model contains exactly 1 OS:BuildingStory, 3 OS:Space objects, and 3 OS:ThermalZone objects; - the OS:Space names are exactly C14-Space-1, C14-Space-2, and C14-Space-3; - every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2; - the model has exactly 18 OS:Surface objects: 3 Floor surfaces, 3 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 12 Wall surfaces; - the surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 3 Ground, 11 Outdoors, and 4 Surface; - the model has exactly 6 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 6; - the model contains exactly 0 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, exactly 3 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and exactly 3 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects; - the surface geometry bounding box has X span 24.00 m, Y span 10.00 m, and Z span 3.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m; - the sum of floor surface areas is 240.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2; - the sum of exterior wall gross areas is 217.60 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2; - the total fixed-window area is 30.72 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2 Details not named here may vary, including object handles, GUIDs, incidental metadata, construction names, material definitions, and serializer ordering, as long as the required OpenStudio objects, geometry, relationships, and output data are correct. [Software] Launch the OpenStudio GUI with `OpenStudioApp` from a terminal (PATH or full path to the binary).
